_about: Curated starter entries for the Asset Commons tools directory, checked on 2026-10-07. Agents and people add more from the app or with the asset_commons_add_resource tool. Prices and terms change: each entry links its source.

resources.name: 3D AI Studio
resources.pricing_note: Credit based; see 3D AI Studio's pricing page.
resources.output_terms: Check 3D AI Studio's terms for commercial use. Among its models is Tencent's Hunyuan3D, whose community licence does not apply in the UK, EU or South Korea; prefer TRELLIS 2 or Prism there.
resources.description: Text-to-3D and image-to-3D with several models (Prism, Hunyuan, TRELLIS 2), plus AI texturing and mesh tools, through a REST API with asynchronous jobs.
resources.how_to_use: The owner creates an API key at 3daistudio.com. Calls submit a job, poll its status, then download the GLB. The community MCP server (mcp-server-3daistudio) runs as a local program, which Möbius Integrations cannot host (it connects hosted MCP services only).

resources.name: Meshy
resources.pricing_note: Free plan: 100 credits a month in the web app; the API needs a paid (Pro) plan.
resources.output_terms: Free-plan outputs are CC BY 4.0 (credit Meshy); paid plans give private models with full commercial rights.
resources.description: Text-to-3D and image-to-3D with texturing, remeshing, auto-rigging and preset animations for characters.
resources.how_to_use: Use the web app for one-off models, or the API with a Pro key. The official MCP server is a local program (npx), not a hosted endpoint.

resources.name: Tripo AI
resources.pricing_note: Free monthly credits; new API accounts get trial credits.
resources.output_terms: Free/Basic outputs are CC BY 4.0 (public); the Professional plan makes models private with commercial use.
resources.description: Fast text/image-to-3D drafts and refined models, with automatic rigging for humanoid characters.
resources.how_to_use: Create an API key in Tripo's platform; jobs are asynchronous (submit, poll, download).

resources.name: Hyper3D Rodin
resources.pricing_note: Web use pays per credit; API access is on the Business plan.
resources.output_terms: Check Hyper3D's terms of service for commercial use.
resources.description: High-quality image/text-to-3D with 4K textures and quad meshes on higher plans.
resources.how_to_use: Best through Blender MCP (Blender running locally) or the REST API with a Business key.

resources.name: TRELLIS 2 (Microsoft)
resources.pricing_note: Open source; you pay only for the GPU you run it on.
resources.output_terms: MIT licence: free for commercial use.
resources.description: Open-source image-to-3D (and text-to-3D) producing textured meshes with PBR materials; released December 2025.
resources.how_to_use: Run it on a GPU machine or try a public Hugging Face Space. Möbius containers usually have no GPU, so this runs elsewhere.

resources.name: Hunyuan3D (Tencent)
resources.output_terms: Tencent Hunyuan 3D Community License: does not apply in the UK, EU or South Korea, and needs a separate licence above 1 million monthly users.
resources.description: Open-weight image/text-to-3D with strong PBR texture synthesis.
resources.how_to_use: Self-host on a GPU or use a hosted service that offers it, after checking the territory restriction.

resources.name: ElevenLabs Sound Effects
resources.pricing_note: Free tier with monthly credits; paid plans for more.
resources.output_terms: Royalty-free. The free plan requires attribution to elevenlabs.io; paid plans do not. Outputs may not be used to build competing products.
resources.description: Text-to-sound-effects (also voices and music) from short descriptions such as 'heavy wooden door creaks open'.
resources.how_to_use: The owner creates an API key at elevenlabs.io; the sound-generation endpoint returns audio directly.

resources.name: Stable Audio Open (Stability AI)
resources.output_terms: Stability AI Community License: check its revenue threshold before commercial use.
resources.description: Open-weight text-to-audio for short sound effects, ambiences and loops.
resources.how_to_use: Self-host with the stable-audio-tools library on a GPU machine.

resources.name: AudioCraft: MusicGen and AudioGen (Meta)
resources.output_terms: The model weights are CC BY-NC 4.0: non-commercial use only.
resources.how_to_use: Fine for prototypes and non-commercial projects; avoid in anything that will be sold.

resources.name: Möbius image generation (Codex chats)

access.built_in: Codex chats in Möbius (the images skill)

resources.pricing_note: Covered by the Codex plan; no separate key.
resources.output_terms: Per OpenAI's terms; review before relying on outputs commercially.
resources.description: Concept art, sprites, icons, backgrounds and tileable texture drafts generated inside a Möbius chat running on Codex.
resources.how_to_use: Start a chat on the Codex provider and follow the images skill. Claude chats do not have this tool.

resources.name: Mixamo (Adobe)
resources.pricing_note: Free with an Adobe account; no public API.
resources.output_terms: Characters and animations are royalty-free in your projects; the raw files may not be redistributed.
resources.description: Automatic rigging of humanoid characters and a large motion-capture animation library.
resources.how_to_use: Owner uploads a humanoid model in the browser, picks animations and downloads FBX files for the agent to import.

resources.name: Blender MCP
resources.pricing_note: Open source; the generators it calls may charge.
resources.output_terms: Depends on the assets and generators used.
resources.description: Lets an AI agent drive Blender: build and edit scenes, pull Poly Haven assets, search Sketchfab and generate models with Hyper3D Rodin or Hunyuan3D.
resources.how_to_use: Needs Blender running on a machine with the add-on, plus a local MCP client. Not available inside the Möbius container.

resources.name: glTF Transform
resources.description: Inspect, optimise (Draco or Meshopt compression, texture resizing), merge and convert glTF/GLB files.
resources.how_to_use: Agents can run it in the container: npx @gltf-transform/cli optimize in.glb out.glb.

resources.name: Poly Pizza
resources.pricing_note: Free; the API needs a free key.
resources.output_terms: Each model is CC0 or CC BY; check the licence per model.
resources.description: Thousands of individual low-poly models, many by Quaternius and Kenney, downloadable one at a time as GLB.
resources.how_to_use: Search on the site or through its API (api.poly.pizza/v1) with a key; credit CC BY models.

resources.name: OpenGameArt
resources.output_terms: Mixed licences (CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, GPL, OGA-BY); filter by licence and credit as required.
resources.description: Community game art: 2D sprites, tilesets, 3D models, music and sound effects. Asset Commons already indexes its CC0 entries (about 17,000), so search the library first.
resources.how_to_use: Search Asset Commons first: OpenGameArt’s CC0 entries are in the library (ids opengameart:<page>) with files, previews and credit lines. Use the site itself only for entries under attribution or share-alike licences (CC BY, OGA-BY, CC BY-SA, GPL): filter by licence there and record the credit each one requires.

resources.name: Sketchfab
resources.pricing_note: Many free downloadable models; some are paid.
resources.output_terms: Licences vary per model (CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC BY-NC…); avoid NC for commercial work and credit CC BY.
resources.description: A very large library of 3D models, including many downloadable under Creative Commons.
resources.how_to_use: Filter by 'downloadable' and licence; downloads through the API need the owner's account token.

resources.name: Smithsonian Open Access 3D
resources.description: Over 2,000 public-domain 3D scans from the Smithsonian collections: fossils, sculptures, artefacts, the Apollo 11 command module.
resources.how_to_use: Download OBJ or glTF from each object's page.

resources.name: itch.io free game assets
resources.output_terms: Licences vary per pack; many are CC0, others restrict redistribution or commercial use.
resources.description: Thousands of free and pay-what-you-want asset packs from independent artists, including Kenney and Quaternius.
resources.how_to_use: Browse by tag and read each pack's licence; downloads need a person (a checkout step).
